subject: general
question: As part of the policy to promote para badminton, India's first para badminton academy has been launched in which city in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first para badminton academy has been launched in **Lucknow** in January 2022.
 
• The academy aims to provide world-class training facilities to para badminton players in India.
 
• This initiative is part of the policy to promote para badminton and support athletes in achieving excellence in the sport.
 
• The academy will also serve as a hub for nurturing young talent and preparing them for national and international competitions.
 
• Para badminton has been gaining popularity and recognition, and this academy is a significant step towards the development of the sport in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Para badminton is governed by the Badminton World Federation (BWF) and has been included in the Paralympic Games since Tokyo 2020.
 
• India has a strong contingent of para badminton players who have performed exceptionally well in various international tournaments.
 
• The establishment of such academies will further strengthen India's position in para badminton on the global stage.
 
• Support from the government and private sector is crucial for the success and sustainability of such initiatives.
 
• Training facilities, coaching, and infrastructure are key components that will be provided by the para badminton academy in Lucknow.
